ascii.name: annotate
ascii.ascii:
+------------------ [ RETRY.PY ] ------------------+
|                                                  |
| [1]  def fetch(url, times=3):                    |
|          for attempt in range(times):            |
|              try:                                |
|                  return get(url)                 |
| [2]          except TimeoutError:                |
|                  sleep(2 ** attempt)             |
|                                                  |
| [1]  Three tries.                                |
| [2]  Only timeouts retry.                        |
|                                                  |
+--------------------------------------------------+

| ×  Mongo     no joins we trust                   |
| ○  SQLite    fine until the second writer        |
|                                                  |
| Revisit if writes pass 2k a second.              |
|                                                  |
